{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes bottom before model-adjusted bases",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive correlates with model-underestimated price rebounds",
    "When price is in a downtream, model bases are too high, creating systematic undershoot on the downside",
    "Sentiment exhaustion (repeated 0.00 or low values) precedes model-base divergence from true outcomes",
    "Model base calculation using linear regression on prices alone fails to capture inflection point dynamics",
    "Sentiment momentum (sequential changes) provides correction for model bases that pure price regression misses",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive, model bases remain too low relative to true outcomes"
] }
